# dsh-download-progress
**Live download progress for DeepSeek Harness — no more staring at a silent chat while the agent dow
nloads a 1 GB installer.**
> Same UI in light theme: `docs/screenshot-light.png`
The cards in the top-right corner are rendered by this plugin's client half (`lib/client.js`); the n
umbers come from the real download worker (`skills/download-progress/scripts/dl.mjs`).
## Features
- 💬 **Live progress card in the top-right of the chat window** — percentage, bar, downloaded / total
, instantaneous speed, **ETA**, and current phase (probe → connect → download → reconnect → done). C

ancel with one click; finished cards auto-collapse.
- 📏 **Pre-flight probe** — `dl start` resolves t

otal size first, then estimates duration from the per-host speed history.
- 🔁 **Resumable** — automa
tic reconnect-and-resume after a 20 s stall (up to 8 attempts); after cancel/failure, `dl resume` co

ntinues from the `.part` file.
- 🩹 **Self-healing cards** — if the worker dies (crash, killed shell)
, the card greys out as *interrupted* within 6 s and the status is healed to `failed` in 20 s, so no

thing hangs on screen forever.
- 📦 **Zero dependencies, zero host patching** — plain cordis plugin (
`cordis.patch.yml`), client half auto-injected through the `./client` export, Node ≥ 18 standard lib
rary only. All data stays on your machine.
## Install
From the DSH plugin market (once listed): search `dsh-download-progress` → install → restart DSH.

Then in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` add the package to `dependencies` and to `dsh.profile
.bundles`, extract the tarball into that profile's `node_modules/dsh-download-progress`, and restart
les`, extract the tarball into that profile's `node_modules/dsh-download-progress`, and restart DSH.
Prefer the prebuilt tarball: <https://github.com/Beership/dsh-download-progress/releases/download/v0
.3.2/dsh-download-progress-0.3.2.tgz>
## Usage
After install + restart, just ask in a session:
> Download https://example.com/electron-v33.2.0-win32-x64.zip to `D:\Downloads` and show live progre
Download https://example.com/electron-v33.2.0-win32-x64.zip to `D:\Downloads` and show live progress
The agent calls the bundled skill, a worker starts in the background, and every `dl.mjs` download (f
rom any agent/session) shows up on the progress cards.
CLI, if you want to drive it yourself:

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Why the worker is launched through WMI on Windows
A one-shot command executor (DSH's `ops_bash` and friends) kills the whole process tree it spawned a
s soon as the command returns — a `detached` child included, via a Windows job object. On Windows th
e worker is therefore spawned by `Win32_Process.Create` through `WmiPrvSE`, whose parent is outside
that job object; on POSIX `detached: true` (`setsid`) is enough. Because WMI children do not inherit
the caller's environment, the job home is passed explicitly as `--home`.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Layout:
| Path | Purpose |

| `lib/index.mjs` | cordis plugin: HTTP API + stale-job self-healing + skill installation |
| `lib/c

lient.js` | web client: polling, card rendering, cancel, auto-collapse |
| `skills/download-progress

/` | the agent skill (`SKILL.md` + `scripts/dl.mjs`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch that inse

rts the plugin into the runtime |
| `test/`, `scripts/` | smoke tests and the screenshot generator |
## Changelog
- Job home is passed to the worker as `--home` — fixes downloads that stayed at `queued/probe` when
`AGENT_DL_HOME` was customized (WMI children inherit the provider's environment, not the caller's).

- `status --json` always prints valid JSON (`[]` when there is no job).
- Filename falls back to the

URL path when the server sends no `Content-Disposition`.
- Card: reconnect shows `重连中…` instead of
`测速中…`; `✕` is keyboard accessible (`role=button`, Enter/Space); fewer needless re-renders; `dismiss

ed` set is capped.
- Skill installation is skipped when the version is unchanged, so local edits sur

vive restarts.
- Added smoke tests, a screenshot generator and CI.
- **Root cause of “stuck at 3 % / cards never disappear”**: the executor reclaimed the worker's proc
ess tree right after `dl start` returned, so `status.json` stopped updating. Fixed by launching the

worker through WMI on Windows (`Win32_Process.Create`) and `setsid` on POSIX.
- Status writes retry

and fall back to a plain overwrite on `EPERM/EBUSY` (Windows rename contention).
- Adaptive polling,
client-side 6 s staleness detection, terminal cards auto-collapse (4 s done / 12 s failed or cancel
led, paused while hovering).
